intro: An Enchanting Lesson is a quest offered by Kitta Firewind at the Tower of Azora in Elwynn Forest. It instructs practitioners to examine the crude wax effigies of kobold geomancers, proving that practical experimentation is just as vital to enchantment as formal arcane theory.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Academic rigor is of course essential to the enchanter's craft, but a practical foundation can pay dividends. Consider, as an example, the lowly Kobold. Lacking formal education, they nevertheless demonstrate a sort of innate aptitude for simple cantrips and enchantments.
Obtain some of their wax effigies and deconstruct the enchantments bound within them. You may find it elucidating.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Theory and practice are two sides of a coin, friend. Remember this.
